title: The truth about ONECOIN. Is it a scam?

asr.full_text: In the last months they contact us for a great opportunity that can change our life an extraordinary opportunity an opportunity with which already many people are earning millions of euros every month here is our private jet and what do we have to do to change our lives? Very simple, we have to register at OneCoin and invest from 100 to 12.500 euros Even better 25.000 euros, so you can earn more But now comes the beauty, we explain you where these money come from Where do these money come from? I don't know We understood that this is a boy who invested 20$ in Bitcoin and not in OneCoin and after a while he found 850.000$ on the account But why? Because he bought the Bitcoins at a price and then sold them at a much higher price after a few years. But all this has nothing to do with OneCoin. The only thing we have understood is that if you want to earn with OneCoin you have to bring other people who invest another 12,500 euros, 25,000 better because you earn more. Now that Brexit has just passed, imagine wanting to earn on the euro sterling exchange and imagine if the bank tells you to look, if you want to earn on the Eurosterline exchange if you want to earn by buying the Eurosterline then you have to take other people who buy other Eurosterlines Absurd, isn't it? If I want to earn on the exchange I buy the Eurosterlines at a lower price and then I sell them again when the price will be higher but for sure no one has to bring anyone to the bank. Another thing we've understood is that you don't buy one coins spending 12,500 euros, but you buy training packages to trade with this one coin. Let's go back to the example of before. Imagine going to the bank to buy the sterling and the bank tells you, look, actually you're not buying the sterling and the bank says look, in reality you are not buying the sterling but you are buying training packages on how to trade with the sterling. And the bigger the training package you buy, the more sterling we give you. But what a speech is this? If I want the sterling I buy the sterling, not the training package on how to trade with the sterling. But there is one thing that is known for sure about OneC stars, but there is one thing you know for sure about onecoin the profit is spectacular invest 1000 euros and then after a while you find yourself with 100,000 on your account. Fantastic! Where do all this money comes from? We don't know. But what the fuck do you care? 100,000! Right? Apart from joking, guys be. If somebody expects you to do money without doing anything, something is wrong. Come on guys, don't make a fool of yourself like this, please. If you have 25,000 euros to throw away, we give you our IBAN and at least you have done a good deed. Yeah! Because we have just founded Only One Coin. And do you know the truth about Brexit? I'm telling you. Great Britain has left Europe because it wants to use the only one coin Ready Elisabetta? How many do I send you? So guys, remember the rule number one of fraud, but someone will come and promise you something in exchange for nothing and then in reality, he will give you nothing in exchange for something Come on guys, a little reasoning, a little good sense, really, do not get caught up in this way, please Pay attention

textual.observation: The source describes a OneCoin opportunity tied to registering and investing 100 to 12,500 euros, with a higher amount presented as a way to earn more, alongside claims that many people earn millions every month.

evidence.quote: an opportunity with which already many people are earning millions of euros every month
we have to register at OneCoin and invest from 100 to 12.500 euros Even better 25.000 euros, so you can earn more

textual.context: The surrounding source presents and questions these claims in a critical discussion; it does not establish that the claims are true or that any person earned money.
textual.potential_relevance: A substantial return claim is linked to registration and monetary investment, which may require later assessment of the offer and its conditions.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish actual returns, payment outcomes, the identity of the speaker, or whether the described offer was currently available.

textual.observation: The source states that earning with OneCoin requires bringing other people who invest, with a larger investment by those people presented as producing higher earnings.

evidence.quote: if you want to earn with OneCoin you have to bring other people who invest another 12,500 euros, 25,000 better because you earn more

textual.context: This is described within a skeptical explanation comparing the arrangement to ordinary currency exchange; the source does not make clear whether the speaker is quoting or reproducing an official OneCoin condition.
textual.potential_relevance: A promised earning outcome is linked to recruiting additional investors and their monetary contributions, a relationship that may require later review.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish the full compensation structure, whether recruitment was mandatory in practice, or whether any transfer occurred.

textual.observation: The source describes an apparent mismatch between paying for OneCoin and receiving training packages on how to trade, with the size of the package linked to the amount of OneCoin provided.

evidence.quote: you don't buy one coins spending 12,500 euros, but you buy training packages to trade with
you are not buying the sterling but you are buying training packages on how to trade with the sterling. And the bigger the training package you buy, the more sterling we give you.

textual.limitations: The records do not provide written terms, transaction details, or independent confirmation of what purchasers received.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it critiques OneCoin and explicitly questions its promises of extraordinary profits rather than endorsing them. The speakers warn viewers that earning requires recruiting additional investors, distinguish Bitcoin gains from OneCoin, and advise viewers not to participate. Although the description includes an external link, the video does not establish that viewers should send money or data there.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: Questioning the source of the claimed earnings and directly cautioning viewers make examination and warning the main content context.
